name: Doge
subject: Kabosu, a Shiba Inu
origin: Photographed by her owner Atsuko Sato, sitting on a couch at home, for Sato's blog in 2010; it became a meme in late 2013.

sources.label: Know Your Meme — interview with Atsuko Sato

cultural_meaning: A sideways glance with raised eyebrows, captioned with broken, wondering phrases ('such wow') — mock astonishment, affectionate and absurd.

reflection.en: Such a long sideways look. I think this dog understands something I don't.
reflection.ru: Такой долгий взгляд искоса. Кажется, эта собака понимает что-то, чего не понимаю я.
reflection.de: So ein langer Seitenblick. Ich glaube, dieser Hund versteht etwas, das ich nicht verstehe.

notes: Pose from the KYM interview: sitting on a couch, glaring sideways with raised eyebrows. Eyebrows cannot be performed; the robot sits.
discovered_via: manual (Imgflip lists only This Is Fine and Buff Doge vs. Cheems)
